name: us3-adopt-preserve
description: 003 US3 (T112): adopt, then reconcile TWICE. Stamping origin `human` is what selects the managed-panel splice, so the first reconcile ADDS the panel below the hand-written description with every pre-existing byte intact, and performs no creation, deletion or transition on the adopted ticket. The second reconcile — given the state the first one left — writes NOTHING at all, because churn on a human-origin ticket is measured on the managed section alone (SC-002, SC-006, FR-018).
